= Frameworks

Web application frameworks and related tooling, organized by category.

* https://todomvc.com/[TodoMVC]

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/server-side/index.adoc[*Server-side*] \
  Server-side frameworks, mostly for Node.js. Express and Fastify have their own
  dedicated pages.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/client-side/index.adoc[*Client-side*] \
  Client-side JavaScript frameworks, organized by category.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/other-web-ui-frameworks/index.adoc[*Other web UI frameworks*] \
  Web UI frameworks that don't fit the other categories, including Java-based and
  platform-specific toolkits.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/static-site-generators/index.adoc[*Static-site generators*] \
  Static-site generators that aren't based on a component framework, including
  tools focused on technical documentation and books.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/web-game-engines-vr-and-ar/index.adoc[*Web game engines, VR and AR*] \
  Game engines and frameworks for building web-based games, VR, and AR
  experiences.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/frontend-starter-kits/index.adoc[*Frontend starter kits*] \
  Framework-agnostic starter kits and boilerplates for bootstrapping frontend
  projects.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/full-stack/index.adoc[*Full-stack*] \
  Full-stack frameworks and libraries that blur the line between client and server
  code.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/meta-frameworks/index.adoc[*Meta frameworks*] \
  Meta-frameworks built on top of React, Vue, Angular, and other component
  frameworks, adding routing, SSR, and other conventions.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/email-design/index.adoc[*Email design*] \
  Frameworks and tools for building HTML emails that render consistently across
  email clients.
